what_does_it_do: Enables Registration, Discovery, and Connection Management of [JPEG XS](https://jpeg.org/jpegxs/) Endpoints using the AMWA IS-04 and IS-05 NMOS Specifications.
why_does_it_matter: It helps ensure consistency between implementations offering NMOS control for JPEG XS endpoints.
how_does_it_work: It specifies what resources and attributes MUST be provided when using NMOS with JPEG XS streams.
It specifies requirements for SDP files.
It provides examples of how to use IS-04 and IS-05 in the context of JPEG XS streams - specifically JPEG XS encapsulated in RTP as described in IETF [RFC 9134](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc9134).
